Select exact IC50 activity rows for human Cytochrome P450 2D6. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, compound_records, and compound_structures. Filter by target name 'Cytochrome P450 2D6' and target organism 'Homo sapiens' and standard_type 'IC50'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate.
